lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Ukrainian officials fear their country’s fate could be determined by agreements between Trump and Putin, raising concerns among European governments, The Associated Press reports.
Grand Theft Auto 6 has officially arrived, sparking excitement among Calgary gamers, CityNews Calgary reports.
Netflix is gearing up for a busy holiday streaming season, and two of its newest releases were filmed around Metro Vancouver and in B.C, Daily Hive reports.

Nova Scotia’s official Opposition and a physician specializing in gynecological cancer are urging the province to speed up the launch of a testing program to screen for cervical, The Canadian Press reports.
The Cincinnati Zoo’s animal care team has been working for days to help its beloved hippo Fiona safely digest and pass a knit cap she swallowed, The Associated Press reports.
Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya minority, top UN court rules, BBC News reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
